# Alepo

> Alepo makes network access, billing, provisioning and customer care software for communication service providers, with AI built in. Operators of every size run it, from MVNOs preparing a launch to tier-1 groups with millions of subscribers on several continents.

- [AI-native AAA and BSS software for telecom operators](https://alepo.com/): Alepo Technologies builds AAA, charging, billing and AI software for telecom operators, ISPs and MVNOs. Cloud-native, carrier-grade, in production since 2004.
- [Telecom software products](https://alepo.com/products/): Telecom software for operators and ISPs: AAA, provisioning, charging, billing, policy, CRM and self-care, with AI built in. Run one product or the full stack.
- [Solutions for telecom operators](https://alepo.com/solutions/): Alepo solutions for telecom operators and ISPs: fiber and cable, mobile, MVNOs and MVNEs, Wi-Fi and venues, and enterprise networks. Start with your network.
- [Services and support](https://alepo.com/services/): Alepo telecom software deployment and support services: Kubernetes installs run by you or by Alepo, professional services and 24x7 GTAC support.
- [AI for telecom operators](https://alepo.com/products/ai-for-telecom/): AI in telecom on your live data: AI Agent Assist for care and NOC staff in the AAA, TACACS+ and CRM consoles (beta), and a virtual agent for your subscribers.
- [Customer stories](https://alepo.com/customers/): Alepo case studies from telecom operators of every size: AAA upgrades, BSS migrations, MVNO launches and public Wi-Fi, with the results each one achieved.
- [About Alepo](https://alepo.com/company/about/): Alepo Technologies makes access control and BSS software for communication service providers, with AI built into both. Based in Austin, Texas, since 2004.
- [Leadership](https://alepo.com/company/leadership/): Meet the Alepo leadership team: the people who lead Alepo Technologies across product, technology, delivery, sales and support for operators worldwide.
- [Partner program](https://alepo.com/company/partners/): The Alepo partner program for resellers and system integrators. Deliver Alepo AAA, BSS and AI software to operators in your markets, with partner training.
- [Security](https://alepo.com/company/security/): How Alepo protects operator and subscriber data: encryption, access control, monitoring, AI safeguards, incident response and your choice of data location.
- [Careers at Alepo](https://alepo.com/company/careers/): Careers at Alepo Technologies. Build telecom software that connects and bills subscribers on live networks, with a team that has done it for two decades.
- [News and events](https://alepo.com/news/): Alepo news and events: customer launches, product announcements and partner news, and where to meet the Alepo team at telecom events worldwide.
- [Resources](https://alepo.com/resources/): Telecom software resources from Alepo: guides for network and BSS teams, product datasheets and white papers, customer case studies and company news.
- [Blog](https://alepo.com/blog/): Telecom guides for network and BSS teams: RADIUS, AAA, TACACS+, charging, policy, provisioning and billing, explained by the engineers behind Alepo's software.
- [Library](https://alepo.com/library/): Alepo telecom product datasheets and white papers, plus case studies for AAA, TACACS+, charging, policy, BSS and AI. Download the details your evaluation needs.
- [Contact Alepo](https://alepo.com/contact-us/): Contact Alepo to request a demo, talk to sales, submit an RFP or reach 24x7 customer support. Offices in North America, Latin America, Asia Pacific and Africa.
- [Software for fiber and cable ISPs](https://alepo.com/solutions/fibre-cable-isps/): ISP software for fiber and cable providers: authentication, activation and home-router management, plus ISP billing software, collections and care, connected.
- [Software for mobile operators](https://alepo.com/solutions/mobile-operators/): BSS and charging software for mobile operators: real-time charging and policy, Wi-Fi where radio coverage ends, and one BSS for prepaid and postpaid.
- [Software for MVNOs and MVNEs](https://alepo.com/solutions/mvnos-mvnes/): MVNO platform and MVNE software from Alepo: a defined launch package for a new brand, and real-time charging and settlement for the enabler that hosts several.
- [Captive portal and carrier Wi-Fi for venues and operators](https://alepo.com/solutions/wifi-venues/): Captive portal software and carrier Wi-Fi for operators and venues: automatic SIM login for mobile subscribers, plus branded login and paid passes for venues.
- [Device administration for enterprise and government networks](https://alepo.com/solutions/enterprise-government-networks/): A supported Cisco ACS replacement for enterprise and government networks: one place to control who logs into every network device, with every command recorded.
- [AAA Server for telecom operators](https://alepo.com/products/aaa-server/): Alepo AAA server keeps only paying customers online, at the speed they bought. Plan changes and payment holds reach live sessions with no reconnect.
- [Service Provisioning and Activation](https://alepo.com/products/service-provisioning/): Fulfilment Manager is Alepo's telecom provisioning product. Every activation, suspension and plan change reaches the right network element and is confirmed.
- [TACACS+ Server for network device administration](https://alepo.com/products/tacacs-server/): Alepo TACACS+ server controls and records who logs into every network device, from core routers to firewalls, and every command they run, in one audit trail.
- [Wi-Fi Offload and Calling for mobile operators](https://alepo.com/products/wifi-offload-calling/): Wi-Fi offload for mobile operators: subscribers join Wi-Fi with their SIM and keep calling where radio coverage ends. Venues get branded login and paid passes.
- [TR-069 and TR-369 device management](https://alepo.com/products/device-management/): Alepo TR-069 device management lets the helpdesk see and fix home routers and ONTs remotely, from your own servers. A TR-069 ACS and a TR-369 USP controller.
- [Subscriber Data Management (HSS)](https://alepo.com/products/subscriber-data-management/): Alepo subscriber data management: a home subscriber server for 4G and IMS voice, with interworking to another vendor's 5G core in a proof of concept.
- [Digital BSS for telecom operators](https://alepo.com/products/digital-bss/): Alepo Digital BSS is one configurable system to sell, charge, bill, collect and serve customers on mobile and fixed broadband. Buy only the modules you need.
- [Online Charging System (OCS)](https://alepo.com/products/online-charging/): Alepo online charging system charges every call, message and megabyte against the balance in real time. Convergent charging for prepaid, postpaid and MVNEs.
- [Policy Control (PCRF)](https://alepo.com/products/policy-control/): Alepo PCRF policy control for telecom operators enforces data plans by speed, application, time or cap in real time, beside any vendor's core network.
- [Prepaid Offers and Voucher Management](https://alepo.com/products/prepaid-offers-vouchers/): Alepo mobile recharge software lets marketing create prepaid plans, scratch-card and digital top-ups and recharge bonuses, then push them to every channel.
- [Collections and Dunning for telecom](https://alepo.com/products/collections-dunning/): Alepo telecom collections software automates reminders, late fees, service barring and restoration for unpaid bills, with policies by customer segment.
- [Partner and MVNO Settlement](https://alepo.com/products/partner-mvno-settlement/): Alepo telecom wholesale billing onboards partners, rates their traffic and produces invoices and settlement reports, so operators settle without spreadsheets.
- [Telecom Dealer App and Mobile POS](https://alepo.com/products/dealer-mobile-pos/): Alepo Mobile POS is a telecom POS and dealer app that puts customer sign-up, top-ups and bill payments on a dealer's phone, with every sale in CRM and billing.
- [Telecom CRM for customer care](https://alepo.com/products/crm/): Alepo CRM is a telecom CRM that gives care agents one page per customer, with plans, billing, tickets and inventory together, and an AI assistant on the page.
- [Telecom Self-Care Portal](https://alepo.com/products/self-care-portal/): Selfcare Now is Alepo's self-service portal software for telecom: a branded website where customers sign up, pay and get help, in more than 30 languages.
- [White-label telecom self-care app](https://alepo.com/products/self-care-app/): A white-label telecom self-care app for iOS and Android under your brand. Subscribers check usage, recharge, pay bills and change plans from their phone.
- [BSS in a Box for MVNOs](https://alepo.com/products/bss-in-a-box/): BSS in a Box is an MVNO billing platform in one defined offer: self-care, CRM, billing, charging and mobile POS for a new brand, each on its own deployment.
- [Interconnect and Roaming Settlement](https://alepo.com/products/interconnect-roaming-settlement/): Alepo's interconnect billing system for interconnect and roaming settlement is in development. Interconnect invoicing works today in partner settlement.
- [Telecom mediation and revenue assurance](https://alepo.com/products/mediation-revenue-assurance/): Mediation Studio is a telecom mediation and revenue assurance product that collects and cleans every usage record and proves nothing was lost before billing.
- [AI Virtual Agent for telecom](https://alepo.com/products/ai-virtual-agent/): AI customer service for telecom: an AI virtual agent that answers around the clock, completes account tasks and hands complex cases to people.
- [AI Agent Assist for care and NOC teams](https://alepo.com/products/ai-agent-assist/): AI Agent Assist is AI agent assist inside your care and network consoles: it answers staff questions from live data and suggests the next step.
- [Network access and AAA for operators](https://alepo.com/products/network-access-aaa/): Network access and AAA software for operators: subscriber authentication over RADIUS and Diameter, device administration, Wi-Fi offload and subscriber data.
- [Telecom billing software](https://alepo.com/products/billing-bss/): Telecom billing software for operators and ISPs: convergent billing, real-time charging, policy, mediation, collections and settlement in one BSS.
- [Service provisioning and device management](https://alepo.com/products/provisioning-devices/): Service provisioning and device management for operators: automated service activation and TR-069 and TR-369 management of home routers and ONTs.
- [Customer care and channels for telecom](https://alepo.com/products/customer-care-channels/): Customer experience management for telecom: a CRM for care teams, a branded self-service portal and app, and mobile POS for dealers, with AI built in.
- [Sitemap](https://alepo.com/sitemap/): Every page on alepo.com: products by group, solutions, services, resources and company pages.
- [Privacy Policy](https://alepo.com/privacy-policy/): How Alepo collects, uses and protects personal information on alepo.com.
- [Cookie Policy](https://alepo.com/cookie-policy/): Which cookies alepo.com uses and how to turn them off.
- [Accessibility statement](https://alepo.com/accessibility/): How Alepo works to make this website usable for everyone, the standard it aims to meet and how to tell us about a barrier.
